label: intellitex-t5-220m/decode128

provenance.summary: T5 decode-step, encoder length 128, cache 256: one greedy token per dispatch over static self-attention caches.

source.precision: float16 weights; RMSNorm variance in float32

recordedFrom.recorder: bench/webnn/ir-record.js (Proxy around MLGraphBuilder; shapes are the backend's)
recordedFrom.label: intellitex-decode-L128

folds: decoder relative bias gathered on axis 2 of Hugging Face [1, heads, query, key] layout (a reshape to [N, heads, N] is not a transpose)
layer 0's relative-bias table reused on every decoder layer, matching Hugging Face
tied lm_head = embedding^T scaled by d_model^-0.5
in-graph cache update; argMax token readable; logits not on the timed graph

note: One operand namespace: graph inputs keep their names, constants are k<N>, op results v<N>. Decode cache outputs are named *_out so they are distinct from the same-named inputs (WebNN will not bind one MLTensor as both).
